authorization: Eigenaar21oktober2026: vergelijk OpenClaw, Hermes en OpenCode, maak ook taken voor het voorafgaande voorstel over zelfstandig mens-/huisbegrip, routines, voorkeuren, humor, initiatief en eigen leven, en werk een ambitieuzere onderscheidende Eva uit. Deze registratie plant uitvoering; een onderzoeksdocument is geen gebouwde functie.
method: Current official documentation checked online; targeted inspection of existing Eva architecture, source and canonical task status. Prior pinned code research retained as historical evidence, not asserted to be latest upstream code.

sources.observed: Event-conditioned prospective memory checked before eligible interactive replies; aspirations and clock schedules are distinct.
sources.use: Responsibility lifecycle, cancellation and event-conditioned followthrough scenarios in existing Eva attention/tasks.
sources.limit: An interactive intent check alone does not demonstrate unsolicited useful household activity.

sources.observed: System-owned automation runs periodic main-session turns; recurring cadence and event wakes have distinct controls.
sources.use: Attention ownership, foreground priority and event coalescing scenarios; Eva already has its own attention lane.
sources.limit: Do not add another scheduler or equate repeated model calls with a living entity.

sources.observed: On-demand AgentSkills documents and agent-managed creation/patching retain reusable procedures from experience.
sources.use: Reuse already integrated E4.12 packages and capture a generalizable procedure from an actually used new household creation.
sources.limit: A saved skill is not proof of improved outcome, authority or later reuse.

sources.observed: Usage-aware idle maintenance proposes patches/consolidation and recoverable archival of agent-created skills.
sources.use: Usage and outcome evidence in the existing dream/AIDE route, preserving proven sources and independent review.
sources.limit: Do not copy archival thresholds as proof that a file or skill is unnecessary; no second curator process.

sources.observed: Persistent goal continuation uses a completion judge and feeds continuation into the same session within a turn budget.
sources.use: Existing E1.4 goals and responsibility progress; distinguish continuing work from achieving a meaningful result.
sources.limit: Do not add a mandatory judge per household interaction or copy a second goal database.

sources.observed: Programmatic tool calls through an RPC stub can retain intermediates outside model context.
sources.use: Use already delivered E4.14 task programs when a new household creation combines services.
sources.limit: Eva retains per-action authority, STOP and independent readback; no host credentials in generated code.

sources.observed: Language-server diagnostics can feed the agent; current docs also warn that CLI diagnostics can be preferable in some projects.
sources.use: Reuse E4.13 source-version-bound diagnostics or existing CLI checks while Eva makes a useful extension.
sources.limit: No universal LSP speed/quality advantage and no reason to rebuild delivered E4.13.

sources.observed: SDK exposes programmatic session control, including prompt, abort, messages, structured output and events.
sources.use: Candidate bounded coding executor behind the existing programming port only if its remaining integration gap and quality advantage are demonstrated.
sources.limit: Not selected or installed here; no second Eva identity, household memory or extra paid provider.

sources.observed: Headless HTTP server publishes OpenAPI and events, supporting integration without terminal scraping.
sources.use: Inspect typed integration surface before writing a terminal-based coding-agent wrapper.
sources.limit: External coding proposals remain untrusted task output; SDK and server documentation do not establish compatibility with Eva.

ownProposal.outcome: Eva develops a household-specific repertoire of genuinely useful creations, responsibilities, shared experiences and evolving own projects.
ownProposal.cycle: noticed unmet need -> investigate meaning and alternatives -> choose feasible creation or responsibility -> existing authorized execution and independent evaluation -> ordinary actual use -> feedback/counterevidence -> improved later behavior or artifact
illustrationsNotScriptedAcceptance: A small household tool that Eva invents from observed recurring friction and subsequently maintains.
A developing game, story or other creative work tied to real shared interests and appropriate feedback.
A household preparation problem noticed before it happens, with relevant alternatives and checked later outcome.
ownProposal.differenceToProve: Integrated self-selected value and sustained ordinary use, beyond having memory, a scheduler, a code executor or a saved skill.

reuseDecision: Use delivered Eva contracts and capabilities first; copy or adapt pinned, license-reviewed upstream units only for a demonstrated remaining gap. OpenCode SDK is a candidate, not a selected deployment. No second identity, household memory, scheduler or always-on agent stack.
acceptance: Per-task original criteria plus actual family judgments in existing F2; no mechanical humor score, message quota, automatic causal inference or general better-than-all-agents claim.

usage.measurementScope: Five web tool invocations in this user turn through the documentation checks; development agent token/credit accounting unavailable. No Eva instance, model or physical house action invoked. Independent reviewer reported two additional web tool invocations, accounted separately; total development elapsed time unavailable.

validation.canonicalWorkboard: passed: 95 cards, 78 previously completed; current E1.6 and every old task preserved
validation.dashboardHttpProjection: passed: all six new task IDs returned planned by actual project-state route

legacyProductCompletionCheck.scope: Existing product capability aggregation check is separate from deliveryPlan task projection; no unrelated runtime/UI change made.
